name: Learning regularities in noise (ASRT MEG)
readme:
Summary
----------
This dataset contains magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings collected while participants performed the cued Alternating Serial Reaction Time task, a visuo-motor task during which arrows are displayed and they must respond with response keys.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
